description: Protecting the environment and building a strong economy should not be competing goals. America can produce more energy, create good-paying jobs, modernize its infrastructure, reduce pollution, protect natural resources, and develop the technologies that will power the future. As part of the New American Clean-up, I would support a Green Initiative focused on practical results
